issues.issue: Were the applicants given proper notice of the need to update their submissions, given the email was not received?
issues.applicant_position: Applicant never received the crucial Warsaw email; consultant's email system was diligent and working.
issues.respondent_position: Visa office CAIPS notes recorded the DSN as confirmation of receipt; officer deposed no delivery failure was noticed.
issues.result_quote: I conclude the Applicant was not provided with notice of the requirement to update her application.

issues.issue: Which party bears the risk of the failed email communication?
issues.applicant_position: Placing risk on applicant is unduly harsh; she gave a valid address and was simply waiting for instructions.
issues.respondent_position: Any risk could be mitigated by applicants not choosing email; the sheer volume of visa files justifies its practices.
issues.result_quote: I find the Respondent to bear the risk in the Applicant’s case as well as in the related cases
